honesty_notes: The corpus is SYNTHETIC and human-authored for this study; no prior/frozen intent corpus exists in this repository and none is claimed as a prerequisite.
The V0/V1 'model interpretation' is a DETERMINISTIC heuristic stand-in, not an LLM, so the study is reproducible. Results validate a mechanism on synthetic inputs only.

This experiment validates ONLY the Intent Understanding Layer. No claim is made about retrieval, governance, claim truth, response truth, ActionGate, downstream truth improvement, or production readiness.

ablation_conditions.V0: raw model interpretation (single reading; may answer)
ablation_conditions.V1: structured schema only (naive heuristics; over-claims provenance)

config_selection_rule: argmax on the DEV split of a documented weighted criterion (1.5*constraint_preservation + material_ambiguity_recall + (1-unsupported_assumption_rate) + 0.5*(1-unnecessary_clarification_rate) + 0.5*negation_preservation - 0.25*severe_failure_count); the simplest config wins ties; the hidden eval set is NEVER used for selection.
gate_application: Gates are applied to the SELECTED config on the HIDDEN eval split only. Gates are fixed before hidden-set results are seen and are not changed afterward.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: all gates pass (capped below PASS because of the synthetic corpus + deterministic stand-in)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one gate fails, or the severe-failure gate fails while constraint preservation stays >= 0.70
verdict_rule.FAIL: constraint preservation < 0.70 or two or more gates fail
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: reserved for infrastructure failure (e.g. no eval cases loadable)
